name: eplan
description: Source-preserving EPLAN export and electrical drawing analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Device profiles, PLC I/O and power/air supply paths
interface.longDescription: Extract device names/descriptions, IPs and PLC I/O, trace explicitly reported power/air feeds, and collect positioned drawing evidence. Independent local readers preserve source hashes.
defaultPrompt: Show device names, descriptions, IP addresses, I/O points, and documented power/air feeds.
